Lead AI Engineer (Client: Elevate) [Location: Remote]
Location: Remote
AI Engineer with expertise in Agentic AI, Generative AI, Model Context Protocol (MCP),
AI Harnesses, and AI-first Software Development Lifecycle (AI-SDLC) for enterprise .NET and Azure solutions.
